source: two searches of the frozen Phase 16 simulation (configs/search16.yaml), recorded by scripts/make_demo_v2.py record(): the sweep planner and the lawnmower, four drones, primary camera, perfect radio, the same drone lost at half a sweep's time
not_drawn: single detections and places reported to the crew (counted in a tile)

captions.a1:
Four drones search 4.8 km² for one missing person.
Each colour is the ground one drone has covered.
captions.a2:
They fly in lanes and tell each other what they have covered,
in a few dozen bytes a second.
captions.b:
Drone 3 goes silent: a flat battery, a crash or a lost radio.
The others cannot tell which.
captions.c:
After 60 seconds of silence they count it as lost,
and add the ground it left to their own.
captions.d1: Their own lanes finished, they fly the ground the lost drone left.
captions.d2: Two sightings at the same spot: the person is confirmed and a crew is sent.
captions.e1: The same search without the team plan: each drone keeps to its own strip.
captions.e2: The lost drone's ground is never searched, and the person was in it.

end_card_lines:
Over 300 test searches, losing a drone added 196 s
with the team plan and 365 s without.

A case like this one, with the person on the lost drone's ground, came up in 13 of 200 trial searches.
With no drone lost, neither plan was measurably faster.
Still open: false alarms. Here 2,172 places were reported to the crew before the right one.
